map.计算轮椅坐姿参数和压力分布，预防压疮，优化坐位平衡: Computes wheelchair seated posture parameters and pressure distribution to prevent pressure ulcers and optimize sitting balance
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：ischialPressure ÷ 133.322；: Core formulas (from the input variables): ischialPressure / 133.322; force / (2 x 5); hipW + 2
map.请输入参数计算坐姿优化建议: Enter parameters to compute the seated posture recommendations
map.坐位时坐骨结节承受最大压力，正常约75-100mmHg。超过32mmHg持续2小: The ischial tuberosities bear the highest pressure when seated, normally about 75-100 mmHg. Above 32 mmHg lasting more than 2 hours can cause tissue ischemia, so relieve pressure every 15-30 minutes.
map.座宽 = 臀宽 + 2-3cm（两侧各留1-1.5cm）: Seat width = hip width + 2-3 cm (1-1.5 cm clearance on each side)
map.座深 = 腘窝至臀部后方距离 - 2-5cm（留腘窝间隙）: Seat depth = distance from the popliteal fossa to the back of the buttocks - 2-5 cm (leave popliteal clearance)
map.座高 = 足底至腘窝距离 + 脚踏板高度（5-8cm离地）: Seat height = distance from the sole to the popliteal fossa + footplate height (5-8 cm off the floor)
map.靠背高度：高位截瘫需肩胛下角以上；低位截瘫腋窝下5-10cm: Backrest height: above the inferior angle of the scapula for high-level paraplegia; 5-10 cm below the armpit for low-level paraplegia
map.充气坐垫：减压效果最好，可降低坐骨压力60-70%: Air cushion: best pressure relief, reduces ischial pressure by 60-70%
map.蜂窝硅胶：减压效果好，降低50-60%，稳定性好: Honeycomb silicone: good pressure relief, reduces 50-60%, with good stability
map.凝胶坐垫：降低40-50%，有降温效果: Gel cushion: reduces 40-50%, with a cooling effect
map.记忆棉：降低30-40%，舒适度高: Memory foam: reduces 30-40%, with high comfort
map.普通海绵：降低10-20%，适合低风险患者: Ordinary foam: reduces 10-20%, suitable for low-risk patients
map.📚 深度解析：轮椅坐姿（压力分布）优化: 📝A In-depth analysis: wheelchair seated posture (pressure distribution) optimization
map.髋宽 36cm→理想座宽 38cm；体重 65kg→坐骨压=65×9.8/(2×: Hip width 36 cm gives an ideal seat width of 38 cm; weight 65 kg gives an ischial pressure of 65 x 9.8/(2 x 5) = 63.7 Pa, and a foam cushion reducing pressure by 30% brings it to about 0.33 mmHg equivalent.
map.座深 45>42→理想 40cm，过长致腘窝受压、骨盆后倾，应减 5cm 并加腰: Seat depth 45 > 42, so the ideal is 40 cm; too long presses on the popliteal fossa and tips the pelvis backward, so shorten it by 5 cm and add lumbar support to maintain the lumbar curve.
map.坐垫怎么选？: How do I choose a cushion?
map.低风险用泡沫、中高危用凝胶/充气/蜂窝坐垫（降压 30-60%），每 15-30: Use foam for low risk and gel, air or honeycomb cushions for medium to high risk (30-60% pressure reduction), and lift the hips every 15-30 minutes to prevent pressure ulcers.
map.多久要减压一次？: How often should pressure be relieved?
map.建议每 15–30 分钟做一次减压动作（双手撑起臀部离座 10–15 秒，或身体: Relieve pressure every 15-30 minutes (lifting the hips off the seat with both hands for 10-15 seconds, or leaning forward or sideways), because a cushion can only distribute pressure and cannot replace relief. Patients with existing pressure ulcers need the frequency raised to every 15 minutes. The effect depends on complete unloading, and merely shifting body weight is not enough; patients who can lift themselves are best, otherwise a caregiver must assist on schedule.
